credits.title: Lochia
credits.overview: Over the course of a single harrowing night, May, a pregnant woman trapped in a cycle of addiction, psychosis, and domestic violence goes into labor. As her grip on reality fractures, she is forced to confront both literal and symbolic demons, fighting not only for her own survival, but for the life of her unborn child

credits.title: No More Candy
credits.overview: Felissa Rose (SLEEPAWAY CAMP, VICTOR CROWLEY) faces a dilemma as Siri and Alexa face off on Halloween night in ArieScope's 28th annual Halloween short film.

credits.title: Fresh Meat
credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: Monster Eyes
credits.overview: Every night when her Mother turns out the lights, and walks down the hall, and things get really quiet…. Miriam see them.

credits.title: The Scariest Skeleton
credits.overview: “Little” longs to be scary, but with his tiny roar, none of the other skeletons will let him play. That is, until his unscareable human friend Lily decides to help.

credits.title: Little Bites
credits.overview: Mindy, a young widow and mother who tries to protect her daughter Alice from a flesh eating monster named Agyar. Mindy has been secretly sacrificing her own life by allowing the creature to feast on her body as she keeps Alice hidden away at her grandmother’s house.

credits.title: Trust Me
credits.overview: A young woman's trip to the park with her child takes a dark turn when she finds they are alone with a stranger, whose motives are unknown.

credits.title: HIMS
credits.overview: A mother deals with a sinister entity living in her daughter's room.
